skills.title: Magma Spear
skills.description: You fire a channeled barrage of magma, piercing foes and setting them aflame. Range is 16 meters.

skills.title: Magma Mace
skills.description: You summon an enormous mace of fire that channels the energy of your weapons, stunning foes in a 5 meter arc and setting them ablaze. Magma Mace does not build Charge.

skills.title: Firebombs
skills.description: You hurl three gouts of flame that ignite the ground for 3 seconds and sometimes cause foes to stumble in panic as they burn. Firebombs gain no Charge.

skills.title: Blazing Pillar
skills.description: You create 4 giant pillars of intense flame that seek out and immolate nearby foes. Blazing Pillar is good at building Charge.

skills.title: Infernal Collapse
skills.description: You create a concentrated sphere of heat, which suddenly expands outward in a devastating 4 meter blast.

skills.title: Immolation Aura
skills.description: A vortex of flame surrounds you, damaging foes within a 3 meter radius.

skills.title: Firestorm
skills.description: You call down burning cinders from the sky over a 15 meter radius, setting foes alight and increasing their susceptability to fire damage. Firestorm gains no Charge.

skills.title: Charge Mastery
skills.description: Your expertise with Charge lets you gain it faster, and retain it longer.

skills.title: Elemental Attunement
skills.description: The Embermage is finely attuned to the elements, inflicting elemental effects on nearby enemies and extending the duration of all elemental effects.

skills.title: Fire Brand
skills.description: When you hit a burning enemy, you do an additional burst of fire damage.

skills.title: Icy Blast
skills.description: You unleash a hail of 5 ricocheting icy bolts to slow and immobilize your foes.

skills.title: Hailstorm
skills.description: You call down shards of ice from the sky, pummeling foes within a 15 meter radius. Hailstorm gains no Charge.

skills.title: Frost Phase
skills.description: You vanish from one location and instantly reappear in another, dealing cold damage in both places within a 2.5 meter burst.

skills.title: Elemental Boon
skills.description: You imbue yourself with a bolstering aura which increases your elemental damages and resistances. Boon's benefits are also applied to any allies within 12 meters.

skills.title: Frost Wave
skills.description: You hurl two long columns of icy shards, impaling and freezing foes in their path.

skills.title: Ice Prison
skills.description: You summon pillars of ice around a target, trapping it within. You, however, can pass through the barrier. Pillars reflect damage back at foes attacking them.

skills.title: Astral Ally
skills.description: You summon an astral clone of a fellow Embermage, who joins you in battle with powerful spells.

skills.title: Staff Mastery
skills.description: Your skill with staves lowers the elemental resistances of enemies when you strike them. These effects are also applied to the Magma Mace, Magma Spear, Icy Blast and Shockbolts skills.

skills.title: Frozen Fate
skills.description: When you kill an enemy, you have chance to freeze up to 4 additional enemies within a 7 meter radius.

skills.title: Ice Brand
skills.description: When you hit a frozen enemy, you do an additional burst of ice damage.

skills.title: Prismatic Bolt
skills.description: You unleash a flurry of 5 prismatic bolts that seek out nearby foes.

skills.title: Shocking Burst
skills.description: You unleash channeled bursts of crackling energy, shocking and stunning all foes up to 8 meters away in a 75 degree angle.The energy burst continues and drains mana while the mouse button is held down.

skills.title: Thunder Locus
skills.description: You summon a concentrated thunderstorm at a target location, which blasts foes within 7 meters for the duration of its existence. Thunder Locus does not build Charge.

skills.title: Arc Beam
skills.description: You pierce your foes with a channeled beam of energy from your weapons. Destroyed enemies split the beam and strike nearby targets as a secondary effect.

skills.title: Death's Bounty
skills.description: You bind the lifeforce of all foes within 6 meters of the target. Upon their death, their life and mana are drawn to you or other players through 3 soul bolts. Stated health and mana recovery is per soul bolt.

skills.title: Shockbolts
skills.description: You release 4 electrically charged bolts, which follow the ground and ricochet off neighboring objects

skills.title: Shocking Orb
skills.description: You release a slow-moving electrical orb, which discharges energy into foes as it passes

skills.title: Prismatic Rift
skills.description: Your chaotic energy teleports enemies away when they strike you, with a chance of random elemental effects.

skills.title: Wand Chaos
skills.description: Attacks using your wand can result in bizarre, random elemental disturbances. These effects can also happen with the Magma Mace, Magma Spear, Icy Blast and Shockbolts skills.

skills.title: Lightning Brand
skills.description: When you hit a shocked enemy, you do an additional burst of lightning damage.

skills.title: Flame Hammer
skills.description: Your weapon crushes foes it strikes, creating 4 flaming splinters that seek out enemies within 5 meters. If available, a Charge is consumed to generate two additional blasts.

skills.title: Seismic Slam
skills.description: Your mechanically-assisted stomp stuns and burns all enemies in a 4 meter radius around you.

skills.title: Ember Hammer
skills.description: You deliver a powerful sidelong swing which channels ember energy into a wide, 270 degree arc, destroying shields. Ember Hammer does not gain Charge.

skills.title: Onslaught
skills.description: You leap forward, slamming your melee weapon into the ground. Foes at the point of impact are damaged and slowed significantly. Onslaught gains half of normal Charge.

skills.title: Ember Reach
skills.description: A focused surge of energy draws a foe into striking range. You gain a 20% chance to stun for 3 seconds for every Charge you have, but the skill itself neither gains nor expends Charge.

skills.title: Storm Burst
skills.description: A blast from your pack rockets you swiftly forward, knocking back foes. 3 bolts of energy discharge from your suit on impact, striking remote enemies. Every enemy hit also recharges your mana by 5%, for up to 5 targets.

skills.title: Emberquake
skills.description: A huge overhand smash sends out 8 radiating magma fissures to seek and destroy your enemies.

skills.title: Heavy Lifting
skills.description: Your skill with giant weaponry allows you to attack faster and adds a chance to stun your foes.

skills.title: Supercharge
skills.description: When you hit foes with a melee weapon, you have a chance to direct excess energy into your weapon and then discharge it during attacks over the next 10 seconds. While supercharged you gain additional Charge.

skills.title: Coup de Grace
skills.description: When you hit a stunned target, an electrical surge helps finish the foe off. This ability cannot trigger more than one time per second.

skills.title: Healing Bot
skills.description: You deploy a small drone that generates energy pulses, healing both you and your allies.

skills.title: Blast Cannon
skills.description: You fire a long-range, piercing projectile from your cannon. At higher ranks, the blast leaves foes more susceptible to further fire and physical damage.

skills.title: Spider Mines
skills.description: You deploy a trio of spider drones that charge the nearest foes and explode in a 3 meter radius. Upgraded mines do 20% more damage with a 5 meter radius, a 2 second stun, and electric damage over time.

skills.title: Gun Bot
skills.description: You deploy a small drone that assaults your enemies with a hail of gunfire, firing 5 rounds per second. Each rank increases the bot's damage potential.

skills.title: Shock Grenade
skills.description: You lob a grenade, which shocks and stuns enemies in a 4 meter radius. Consumes one Charge for two additional grenades.

skills.title: Fusillade
skills.description: You unleash a continuous barrage of long-range, homing rockets from your cannon. Bursts of 2 rockets keep firing as long as the mouse button is held down.

skills.title: Sledgebot
skills.description: You construct a powerful Sledgebot to pulverize your foes.

skills.title: Bulwark
skills.description: Your expertise with armor lets you get the most out of it, increasing its effectiveness, and reducing any damage that actually gets through.

skills.title: Fire and Spark
skills.description: The spark to make things work ... and fire to make things die.

skills.title: Charge Domination
skills.description: When you slay an enemy, you have a chance to absorb enough energy to fill your Charge bar. This ability cannot trigger more often than once every three seconds.

skills.title: Shield Bash
skills.description: You smash enemies in front of you, stunning them, slowing their attacks and knocking them back. Damage is equal to 5 times your shield's Armor value. Each Charge you currently have provides an additional 10% damage bonus.

skills.title: Forcefield
skills.description: Your armor projects Ember energy, creating a forcefield around you, and a half-strength forcefield around allies. Once the forcefield absorbs its maximum damage it dissipates, removing all benefits.\nForcefield uses all available Charges to increase damage absorbtion by 50% per Charge.

skills.title: Overload
skills.description: You overload your armor's circuits to project a nova of Ember energy, electrocuting up to 5 foes in a 6 meter radius around you. Overload uses all available Charges to increase its damage by 50% per Charge.

skills.title: Dynamo Field
skills.description: You tap into your armor's energy to project an electrical burst in a 5 meter radius. This electrical surge generates charge for each enemy that is struck, up to five per field.

skills.title: Tremor
skills.description: Discharging the energy from your suit into the earth causes a massive shockwave to expand outward, knocking back and weakening foes within 24 meters. Tremor only does the listed damage when it uses one Charge.

skills.title: Fire Bash
skills.description: You channel a potent blast of energy through your shield up to 6 meters away. Damage is derived from your shield's Armor value. Initial physical damage is tripled and the blast range is increased to 9 meters with one Charge.

skills.title: Immobilization Copter
skills.description: You deploy an immobilization drone which slows enemies within range of its beam. A maximum of 3 targets may be effected at once.

skills.title: Sword and Board
skills.description: Your skill with a shield goes beyond "defense" and straight to "offense," adding some of your shield's armor value directly to your melee attacks as physical damage.

skills.title: Aegis of Fate
skills.description: When foes attack you, your armor has a chance to generate a defensive "bubble" around you that prevents further damage. The amount of damage this shield can absorb is equal to 200% of your Armor plus 100. While the Aegis is active, you also get 50% Knockback Resistance.

skills.title: Charge Reconstitution
skills.description: When you use Charge for skills, you regain some of your Health.

skills.title: Eviscerate
skills.description: You tear into all enemies directly in front of you, leaving them bleeding for 6 seconds. Base range is 2.7 meters within a 120 degree arc. Eviscerate has a 67% Charge rate penalty.

skills.title: Howl
skills.description: You howl in fury, filling nearby foes with terror. Affected foes are slowed and become less able to defend themselves for several seconds.

skills.title: Raze
skills.description: You perform a devastating uppercut that inflicts heavy damage on a single target. With each successive hit, you grow in power. Raze does not generate Charge.

skills.title: Wolfstrike
skills.description: You lunge forward in a 6 meter dash, claws slashing, rending all foes in your path.

skills.title: Battle Rage
skills.description: You enter an enraged state during which your damage is amplified based on the number of foes within 4 meters. The rage lasts for 60 seconds.

skills.title: Rupture
skills.description: You knock a single enemy back with a devastating strike. After a brief delay, the target explodes, damaging all foes within 4 meters.

skills.title: Ravage
skills.description: You execute a brutal series of slashes, inflicting three strikes on all foes within 4 meters. Enemy armor is weakened with each strike.

skills.title: Blood Hunger
skills.description: Whenever you land a critical strike with a melee weapon, you draw life essence from the carnage, healing your wounds.

skills.title: Executioner
skills.description: Your ferocity in combat enables you to more frequently strike with two weapons at once. When you successfully execute, you gain Charge more quickly for a short period of time.

skills.title: Rampage
skills.description:
Each enemy you kill with a melee weapon has a chance of spurring you into an adrenaline-fueled rampage.
 25% Faster Attack for 5 seconds
 25% Cast Speed for 5 seconds
 12% Movement Speed for 5 seconds

skills.title: Frost Breath
skills.description: You channel the frigid north winds to unleash a blast of icy breath, which immobilizes enemies and makes them more susceptible to damage. The blast reaches 5 meters at a 90 degree angle.

skills.title: Stormclaw
skills.description: You imbue your weapons with an electrical energy. This power can cause a lightning bolt to arc toward nearby targets when you strike a foe. The lightning can chain up to 2 times.

skills.title: Storm Hatchet
skills.description: You draw wild northern lightning out of your weapon to create an electrical throwing axe with a range of 15 meters.

skills.title: Northern Rage
skills.description: You unleash an arctic blast from deep inside you, throwing out shards of ice to knock back and freeze nearby foes.

skills.title: Ice Shield
skills.description: You call forth an ice shield which reflects projectile missiles back at attackers. You also have a chance to gain 10% of your Charge Bar when the shield is struck. The shield lasts for 10 seconds.

skills.title: Permafrost
skills.description: The bone-cracking cold of the north expands outward from you, slowly sapping the life of all foes within 16 meters.

skills.title: Glacial Shatter
skills.description: The earth is sundered and 5 geysers burst forth at the target location, blinding and damaging foes with superheated air and water.

skills.title: Cold Steel Mastery
skills.description: The only thing harder than steel is cold steel.

skills.title: Shatter Storm
skills.description: When you kill frozen enemies, you blast nearby foes in a 4 meter ring of frost, leaving them more susceptible to further ice attacks.

skills.title: Rage Retaliation
skills.description: When you are struck by a nearby enemy, your inner rage physically manifests and retaliates against that foe. Damage is equal to 120% of your weapon's DPS. Individual targets can only be hit once per second at most.

skills.title: Shadow Burst
skills.description: You transform into a spectral wolf and lunge through your enemies, damaging them even as you heal your own body. The healing is limited to a maximum of 2 targets per Burst.

skills.title: Wolf Shade
skills.description: You summon a Wolf Shade ally to sink its icy fangs into your enemies and heal you with their lifeforce. The Shade can be summoned once every minute.

skills.title: Shadowbind
skills.description: You bind a group of foes within a 5 meter radius of your target location. All your subsequent melee attacks transfer a percentage of damage to all shadowbound targets.

skills.title: Savage Rush
skills.description: The shadow wolf spirit overtakes you! While the skill remains active, you dash continuously through foes, leaving them bleeding in your wake.

skills.title: Chain Snare
skills.description: Spearing all enemies within 6 meters, you draw them swiftly into melee range.

skills.title: Battle Standard
skills.description: The ancient standard of your tribe imbues you and your allies with increased evasion, resistance to knockback, and increased charge gain while within its 9 meter influence.

skills.title: Wolfpack
skills.description: You unleash a pack of 5 spectral wolves that spread out and attack enemies all around you.

skills.title: Frenzy Mastery
skills.description: Your feral nature grows more powerful and harder to suppress, increasing the duration of your Frenzy states (acquired from filling the Charge Bar).

skills.title: Shred Armor
skills.description: Your inner savagery rips into your enemies' armor, leaving them more vulnerable with each hit, while at the same time stealing some of their armor for yourself.

skills.title: Red Wolf
skills.description: Whenever you inflict a critical hit, up to two neighboring enemies may be savaged by a manifestation of your bloodlust.

skills.title: Rapid Fire
skills.description: You fire a rapid burst of projectiles that force enemies back and strip away their armor. The intial range is 7 meters.

skills.title: Rune Vault
skills.description: You vault swiftly backward, away from your target. This vault leaves behind a mystic sigil that damages and blinds foes in a 4 meter radius.

skills.title: Chaos Burst
skills.description: You fire a trio of chaotic, ricocheting projectiles.

skills.title: Cursed Daggers
skills.description: You fling 9 piercing daggers in a wide arc, which poison and cripple many foes at once, reducing the damage they deal.

skills.title: Vortex Hex
skills.description: You summon a fetish which draws nearby foes toward it and has a chance to stun them. A maximum of 3 foes may be drawn at one time. Max stun chance of 8%.

skills.title: Shattering Glaive
skills.description: You hurl a throwing glaive, which shatters on impact, damaging and slowing all foes within 4.5 meters.

skills.title: Venomous Hail
skills.description: You fire a flurry of poisonous bolts skyward, which streak to earth in a 4 meter radius around the target location. The hail hits with 8 waves per flurry.

skills.title: Long Range Mastery
skills.description: Your expertise increases damage with all ranged weapons. Bows, crossbows, pistols and wands have increased firing distance.

skills.title: Shotgonne Mastery
skills.description: Your expertise with shotgonnes increases the chance that your blasts shock and disorient your targets.

skills.title: Akimbo
skills.description: Your skill with pistols enables you to deal more damage when wielding two at once and occasionally fire both simultaneously... to deadly effect.

skills.title: Glaive Throw
skills.description: You hurl a throwing glaive, slicing through your target, rebounding once to strike additional foes, and generating extra Charge.

skills.title: Tangling Shot
skills.description: You fire a cursed projectile that binds and immobilizes your target. Enemies within a 3.5 meter radius of your target have a secondary chance of also being entangled. Entangled foes are slowly crushed, taking damage over time.

skills.title: Glaive Sweep
skills.description: You sweep your glaive in a 360 degree arc, knocking back and stunning foes within 4 meters, while generating additional Charge for each enemy struck.

skills.title: Sandstorm
skills.description: You hurl your glaive, generating a whirlwind that cuts through foes and saps their health. The sandstorm travels 20 meters and generates 1.5% of your charge bar Charge for every enemy hit.

skills.title: Bramble Wall
skills.description: You call forth a wall of thorned vines that prevent foes from approaching

skills.title: Burning Leap
skills.description: You execute a fiery, spinning leap, up to 7 meters forward. Any foes hit along the way are knocked back and set aflame.

skills.title: Flaming Glaives
skills.description: You hurl two flaming glaives that circle outward in concentric rings, slashing all foes in range and setting them alight.

skills.title: Dodge Mastery
skills.description: Your acrobatic training increases your odds of dodging a blow.

skills.title: Poison Burst
skills.description: You coat your weapons with a venomous agent. If an enemy is killed, there is a chance it will explode in a 6 meter cloud of poison, damaging enemies that come into contact with it.

skills.title: Share the Wealth
skills.description: You share a percentage of your Charge benefits with all pets and allies within 16 meters, and you gain the same percentage as an additional bonus to your own benefits.

skills.title: Blade Pact
skills.description: You invoke an ancient curse that slows your foes and undermines their defenses. The Blade Pact lasts for seven seconds, and any enemy passing through the pact's area suffers the effects for the listed duration.

skills.title: Shadowshot
skills.description: You curse your ammunition, causing it to split into 3 shards upon impact, which seek additional targets.

skills.title: Bane Breath
skills.description: A blast of cursed breath poisons enemies. If they are killed, they are converted into Shadowling Fiends that fight for you for ten seconds. Note that the Death Ritual skill improves all Shadowling summon duration and attack power.

skills.title: Repulsion Hex
skills.description: You summon a floating hex avatar, which repulses enemies who draw too near.

skills.title: Stone Pact
skills.description: You invoke an ancient curse that protects you and your allies from physical and elemental damage and reflects some damage back on your attackers. The Stone Pact lasts for twenty seconds, and any ally passing through the pact's area benefits from its effects for the listed duration.

skills.title: Shadowmantle
skills.description: You call forth a shadow hex protecting you from ranged attackers. The shadowmantle can reflect damage back to the attackers, and it has a chance to blind them for 6 seconds.

skills.title: Shadowling Brute
skills.description: You call forth a terrifying Shadowling Brute at the target location, which lays waste to your enemies.

skills.title: Master of the Elements
skills.description: Your expertise with the elements allows you to deal more damage with them. Poison receives twice the benefit of the other elements.

skills.title: Shadowling Ammo
skills.description: You curse your projectiles with shadow magic that has a chance of converting slain enemies into Shadowling bats that fight for you for ten seconds. Death Ritual improves Shadowling summon duration and attack damage.

skills.title: Death Ritual
skills.description: Your Shadowling allies last longer and deal more damage.
